name: Tuning panel
what: A side panel of live sliders, switches, choices and colours for every feel number in the game, with the game's own value beside each, changed values marked in gold, reset per value, per group or all, search, folding groups, A/B/C slots to compare feels, presets with descriptions, a plain-words short list, freeze and frame step, values kept across reloads, and a one-click hand-back to the agent: Save for my agent (writes src/tuning.json) or Copy changes (a header line plus compact JSON). Games made from the kit starter already have it built in (with game-wide tools, look and sound): this block is for games not made from the starter.
use_when: a person will tune the game's feel by playing it and should hand the exact numbers back to the agent instead of describing them
from_game: TUMEN, Hezarfen, Inkbound, Scrapfall, Still Life 2
good_for: Any game where feel matters and a person plays between agent rounds: movement, jumps, camera, hit-stop, difficulty, colours. Built into the kit starter already; use the block in games not made from the starter, or older starter games. Works in any page with or without three.js.
not_for: Settings menus for players (it is a developer tool, English only, shown on the dev server and ?test=1 pages); values that need a reload to apply (it changes them live).
how_to_add: Games from the kit starter already have it (the dev menu, backquote key): nothing to add. Other games: node tools/blocks/add.mjs meticulai-tuning-panel, then follow 'Using it without the starter' in HOW-TO-USE.md
